summary: FibroBiologics filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting a private placement to its Chief Scientific Officer, Hamid Khoja, Ph.D., of 298,508 shares plus warrants for 298,508 shares at $1.675 per unit, equal to the September 14 consolidated closing bid of $1.55 plus $0.125 per warrant. Gross proceeds are roughly $0.5 million for working capital and general corporate purposes, under Section 4(a)(2). Warrants strike at $1.55, expire in five years, allow cashless exercise, and include standard anti-dilution. This is an insider financing, not a change-of-control or special situation.
